knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The construction team cleans inside the works zone. The hospital clean starts outside the hoarding and is done by facility staff.
The class comes from the combination of activity type and patient area, read from the approved matrix.
Barrier removal waits for inspection and clearance by the infection prevention team, so dust is not spread from the works zone.

practicalCriteria: Given a mock works zone with barriers and a dust mat, the learner checks each barrier and records the gap they find.
The learner names the vacuum type the plan requires and explains why a broom is not used in a clinical area.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
evidenceRequired: Barrier check log for the mock zone
stopWorkCriteria: A barrier has a gap or a broken seal and the infection prevention team cannot be reached
A request is made to remove a barrier before inspection clearance
